theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure of the two named bookkeeping classes never changes the projected source trace
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_projection : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.erase steps) = List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_decisions
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the decided identities alone
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_decisions : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.decisions (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.decisions steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_commit_identities
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the commit identities alone
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_commit_identities : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.commitIdentities (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.commitIdentities steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_crossings
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the read crossings alone
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_crossings : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.readCrossings (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.readCrossings steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_release_members
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the release/retirement members alone
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_release_members : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.releaseMembers (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.releaseMembers steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_commits
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the protected read commits alone
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_commits : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.readCommits (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.readCommits steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_well_formedness
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure cannot repair a forged target trace
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_well_formedness : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.wellFormed (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.wellFormed steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_erase_invariant
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: the relation is erasure-invariant, so an erased class cannot create or remove a source event
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_erase_invariant : ∀ (source : List RegionTrace.SourceEvent) (target : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.related source target = RegionTrace.related source (RegionTrace.erase target)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.denial_projects_to_request_only
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: a refused request stays visible as its request step and gains no response
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.denial_projects_to_request_only : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead false 7] = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.normal_success_projects_request_and_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01: a normal success projects its request and protected commit; decision, copy and return carry no source event
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.normal_success_projects_request_and_commit : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 7, RegionTrace.AbiStep.protectedCopy 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.normalReturn, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.identity_is_decision_identity
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01: the projection keeps the exact identity it was emitted with
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.identity_is_decision_identity : ∀ (kind : RegionTrace.CommitKind) (identity : Nat), RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup kind identity) = some (RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit kind identity)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retirement_is_not_a_guest_release
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: host retirement projects to its own commit kind, never to a guest release
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.retirement_is_not_a_guest_release : ∀ (identity : Nat), ∃ committed, RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.hostRetire identity) = some (RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit committed identity) ∧ committed ≠ RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_class_is_not_in_the_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 premise: the projection carries no abnormal-exit class, so the trap/quota/cleanup distinction is a target-side observation
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_class_is_not_in_the_projection : ∀ (exitClass : RegionTrace.ExitClass), RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.AbiStep.abnormalExit exitClass) = none

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_classes_collapse_in_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 premise: trap and quota exhaustion are indistinguishable in the projection
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_classes_collapse_in_projection : RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.AbiStep.abnormalExit RegionTrace.ExitClass.trap) = RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.AbiStep.abnormalExit RegionTrace.ExitClass.quotaExhaustion)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.append_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: projecting a concatenation is concatenating the projections (prefix compatibility)
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.append_projection : ∀ (first second : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep (first ++ second) = List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep first ++ List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep second

theorems.name: RegionTrace.take_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a trace cut by an exhaustion boundary relates to the projection of its retained prefix
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.take_projection : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep) (bound : Nat), RegionTrace.wellFormed (List.take bound steps) = true → RegionTrace.related (List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep (List.take bound steps)) (List.take bound steps) = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_identity
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01 negative control: a commit identity the host never decided is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_identity : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 9, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_unexplained_read_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: a read commit with no preceding crossing is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_unexplained_read_commit : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 8) 5] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 5, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 8) 5] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_two_guest_releases
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 negative control: a second release is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_two_guest_releases : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 5, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 5] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 5, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 5, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 5] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_missing_protected_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 negative control: a source protected commit missing from the target is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_missing_protected_commit : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 7, RegionTrace.AbiStep.normalReturn] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_host_cleanup_as_guest_release
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: host retirement disguised as a guest release is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_host_cleanup_as_guest_release : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 7, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.hostRetire 7] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_denial_erased_into_success
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: a denial cannot be traded for a success commit
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_denial_erased_into_success : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 7, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_accepts_well_formed_success
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01 positive control: the refusals above are not vacuous
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_accepts_well_formed_success : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] [RegionTrace.AbiStep.importCrossing RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.hostDecision RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead true 7, RegionTrace.AbiStep.protectedCopy 8, RegionTrace.AbiStep.cleanup RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] = true

scope: .cairn/changes/region-trace-relation WIT-TRACE-01 model: source alphabet, target ABI alphabet and the relation.
The target alphabet is a handwritten machine. No emitted ABI step correspondence, no Wasmtime/Canonical ABI claim,
no Rust host or lowering claim, and no liveness claim. Pairing and the host supplying the exact identity stay premises.
